column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable row platform/manifest/<sub>/files/<sha256>/<n> (ADR-0094 B7; the form of outcomes — ADR-0088 addendum (1) R7, addendum (2) S11). A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole row); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.
